title: Data Types and Interfaces
summary: This module defines core data structures and interfaces for interacting with Language Models (LMs), including request/response formats, streaming events, and configuration options.

nodes.label: LMRequest
nodes.title: LMRequest
nodes.description: A normalized request object passed to a Language Model, encapsulating model, messages, tools, and configuration.

nodes.label: LM Message Constructors
nodes.title: LM Message Constructors
nodes.description: Functions like System, Developer, User, Assistant, and ToolResult that create standardized LMMessage objects for different roles in a conversation.

nodes.label: LMStream
nodes.title: LMStream
nodes.description: A synchronous stream for processing Language Model events, building a final LMResponse from a sequence of delta events.

nodes.label: AsyncLMStream
nodes.title: AsyncLMStream
nodes.description: An asynchronous stream for processing Language Model events, building a final LMResponse from a sequence of delta events.

nodes.label: LM Configuration Options
nodes.title: LM Configuration Options
nodes.description: Classes like LMToolChoice, LMReasoningConfig, LMCacheConfig, and LMPromptCacheConfig that define various configuration settings for LM requests.

nodes.label: LM Delta Events
nodes.title: LM Delta Events
nodes.description: Classes representing incremental changes during an LM stream, such as text, thinking, tool calls, citations, images, and audio deltas.

nodes.label: LM Stream Events
nodes.title: LM Stream Events
nodes.description: Classes representing different stages of an LM stream, including start, delta, output end, and end events.

nodes.label: REPLVariable
nodes.title: REPLVariable
nodes.description: Metadata about a variable available in the REPL environment, including its name, type, description, constraints, and a preview.

nodes.label: SandboxSerializable
nodes.title: SandboxSerializable
nodes.description: An abstract base class for types that can be serialized and injected into an RLM sandbox environment, enabling custom data handling.

groups.label: LM Interaction Primitives
groups.title: LM Interaction Primitives
groups.description: Core data types for constructing and managing interactions with Language Models, including requests, messages, and configuration.

groups.label: LM Streaming Interfaces
groups.title: LM Streaming Interfaces
groups.description: Interfaces and event types for handling real-time streaming responses from Language Models, both synchronously and asynchronously.

groups.label: Sandbox Integration
groups.title: Sandbox Integration
groups.description: Data types and interfaces for integrating custom objects into a sandbox environment, facilitating their use in REPL and RLM contexts.
